npcs.name: Dartz
npcs.help:
The ancient king of Atlantis and leader of the Doma organisation, who has lived ten thousand years.

With The Seal of Orichalcos he seals the souls of the Duelists he defeats, to awaken the Great Leviathan.

lines.0:
So you have come.
Then let the Orichalcos judge you.
lines.9: You have walked into my trap.
lines.15:
You dare lay a hand on
the king of Atlantis?
lines.17:
Ten thousand years I have waited.
Behold the power of the Orichalcos!
lines.20:
Why do you hesitate?
Your fate was sealed
the moment you came here.
lines.21: Do not think this is over.
lines.24:
Rise, @@m!
Crush them in the name
of the Orichalcos!
lines.25:
So, another Duelist
has found their way to me.
lines.26:
I am Dartz,
king of Atlantis.
I have watched humanity for
ten thousand years.
lines.27:
Show me the light
in your heart.
lines.28:
And if it is weak,
the Seal will take your soul.
lines.31:
Good.
Your soul is still yours to lose.
lines.35:
Hm…
You have more strength
than I thought.
lines.36:
You are not yet worthy
of my attention.
Begone.
lines.37:
The Seal has claimed
another soul.
lines.43:
Your soul belongs
to the Orichalcos now.
lines.47:
Close?
I was never in danger.
lines.53:
Fate has not yet
chosen between us.
lines.54:
Next time,
the Seal will decide.
lines.63:
The Great Leviathan
will not forget this.
lines.67:
This cannot be…
Ten thousand years…
lines.73:
Few have ever broken
the Seal of Orichalcos.
lines.74:
Take this.
You have earned it.
lines.78:
Remember this victory.
It will not happen twice.
lines.79:
Take this.
You have earned it.
lines.85:
When the Leviathan rises,
I will come for your soul.
lines.86:
And then the world
will be reborn.
